description: S(5) exact metallic coincidence sweep on the 120-word T_w basis of H_5(q) with LP active-set checkpoints (exact Gram).  Design informed by the n≤4 result: coincidence grid is the payload; LP constancy re-tested at ~25 checkpoints instead of a dense Gram sweep.  Conventions, validations, dual-emission and mpfr refinement inherited from metallic_q_s4_exact_lp_sweep.py.
limitations: LP solved at checkpoints (metallic points ± 0.02 and interval midpoints), not on a dense grid — justified by the n=3/n=4 exact-Gram constancy result this re-tests.
coincidence roots f64-bisected; metallic candidates re-verified at 40-dps mpfr (plancherel convention).
